teach.title: Teach
teach.draw_hint: Select a tool, then drag on the picture to mark where it looks.
teach.draw_now: Now drag on the picture around the area to check, then press Auto-find.
teach.no_image: No picture. Take one with the camera or load a stored picture.
teach.no_cameras: No camera found. Check the cable and power.
teach.ng_loaded: NG picture loaded in job {0}, {1}. Saving the job keeps it as the reference picture.
teach.ng_no_job: NG picture loaded in a new job: the job that saved it is not found (renamed or deleted).
teach.ng_missing: That NG picture is no longer kept (the oldest are removed when the disk fills).
teach.no_code: No code found in the area. Mark a bigger area or improve the light.
teach.no_ocr_model: The text reading model is missing from the models folder.
teach.no_text: No text found in the area. Mark the area with the print and try again.
teach.found_text: {0} text line(s) found. Replace the parts that change with fields such as {{BATCH}}.
locate.hint: Mark something on the part that is always the same (a logo, the barcode, a printed patch). The other tools on this camera then move and turn with the part.
locate.draw_now: Drag on the picture around something that is the same on every part, then press Auto-find.
reference.label: Reference
reference.teach: Teach the reference from this good part
reference.taught: Reference taught ({0}×{1} px). Save the job to keep it.
drift.teach_baseline: Teach the baseline (this picture and the test folder)
drift.baseline_taught: Optical baseline taught from {0} pictures. Save the job to keep it.
explain.area.outside: The area to check is outside the picture after the part moved, so it was not checked. Check the part's position and the area.
explain.reference.not_taught: The tool has no taught reference (or one not the size of its area). Teach it from a good part and save the job.
locate.taught: Pattern taught ({0}×{1} px), found again in {2} ms. The other tools now follow the part.
locate.one_per_camera: This camera already has a Find the part tool.
thermal.hint: Inspect bottle induction caps, pouch seams, hot melt glue beads, or blister packs with thermal imaging.
explain.thermal.ng_missing_foil: The bottle induction seal is missing its foil liner or induction heating failed.
explain.thermal.ng_incomplete_seal: The bottle induction seal has a cold gap causing incomplete seal integrity.
explain.thermal.ng_overheated: The induction seal exceeded maximum temperature, risking scorched liner.
explain.thermal.ng_seam_void: The pouch heat seal seam contains a leak channel or void defect.
explain.thermal.ng_missing_bead: Missing adhesive glue bead detected on carton flap.
explain.thermal.ng_blister_barrier_breac: Medicine blister pack cavity moisture barrier seal is breached.
explain.thermal.ng_generic: The seal quality check failed its limits.
infrared.hint: Inspect sub-surface features through opaque plastics, amber glass, SWIR moisture seals, and solar micro-cracks.
explain.infrared.underfill: Liquid fill level is below the minimum required tolerance.
explain.infrared.overfill: Liquid fill level exceeds the maximum permitted tolerance.
explain.infrared.no_meniscus: No liquid meniscus was detected through the container.
explain.infrared.counterfeit_ink: Security ink failed NIR/VIS absorption ratio: counterfeit suspected.
explain.infrared.barrier_breach: SWIR absorption detected a complete moisture breach through packaging seal.
explain.infrared.barrier_thin: Remaining seal barrier width is dangerously thin.
explain.infrared.crack_detected: Micro-crack fracture detected under infrared imaging.
polar.hint: Remove glare from shiny parts and find hidden stress flaws in moulded parts.
explain.polar.glare_excessive: Excessive specular glare blinding the camera field of view.
explain.polar.stress_flaw: Severe internal mechanical stress flaw detected in molded preform.
explain.polar.specular_inclusion: Highly polarized specular inclusion or oil spot detected on surface.
photometric.hint: Find dents, scratches and embossed marks on the surface, apart from the print.
explain.photometric.surface_defect: Surface dent, scratch, or 3D curvature defect detected on part.
explain.photometric.emboss_missing: Embossed stamp, serial code, or Braille mark is missing or incomplete.
explain.photometric.emboss_deformed: Embossed feature exceeds expected area, deformed or blurred.
explain.photometric.low_contrast: Albedo contrast insufficient for reliable printed text/code reading.
wavelet.hint: Homomorphic wavelet filter: suppresses brushed metal, knurling grids, and periodic machining textures to isolate fine hairline scratches and pinholes.
explain.wavelet.scratch_detected: Hairline scratch detected across surface grain.
explain.wavelet.pinhole_detected: Micro-pinhole puncture or seal void detected in packaging foil.
explain.wavelet.excessive_noise: Background surface texture could not be adequately filtered.
inpaint.hint: Anisotropic isophote gradient inpainting: restores barcode tracks, text and edges obliterated by plastic wrap or glossy specular glare.
explain.inpaint.excessive_glare: Excessive specular glare blinding the camera field of view.
rectify.hint: Compensates line-by-line exposure shear distortion for moving parts on high-speed conveyors under rolling-shutter CMOS cameras.
explain.rectify.excessive_shear: Conveyor speed or timing induces excessive shear distortion beyond safe inspection limits.
drift.hint: Monitors baseline optical condition (LED degradation, lens dust, focus drift, flare) using Mahalanobis distance to prevent false line rejects.
explain.drift.optical_degradation: Optical condition degraded: illumination or optical path shifted from taught baseline.
explain.drift.lens_dirt: Lens contamination, smudge or optical defocus detected.
explain.drift.lighting_drop: LED strobe degradation or illumination level dropped below baseline.
explain.drift.overexposure: Excessive optical flare or overexposure blinding sensor.
explain.drift.invalid_image: Optical drift analysis failed: invalid image buffer.
deform.hint: Lines up wrinkled foil pouches, blister cavities and flexible packs with the taught pack and finds film tears.
explain.deform.film_ruptured: Packaging film rupture or foil tear detected across wrinkled surface.
explain.deform.excessive_crumple: Severe pouch crumple, deep fold, or crushed packaging detected.
explain.deform.alignment_failed: Pouch alignment failed: the pack is bent more than the limit.
explain.deform.invalid_image: Deformable matching failed: image buffer invalid.
phase.hint: Log-polar Fourier-Mellin phase correlation: sub-pixel sub-0.01px translation and full 360° rotation alignment with 100% invariance to extreme contrast fade.
explain.phase.not_found: Phase correlation peak below threshold or sidelobe noise excessive.
explain.phase.invalid_image: Phase correlation failed: image buffer invalid.
metamorphic.hint: Metamorphic robustness harness: automated invariant fuzzing across rotation, illumination, noise, scale, and quiet zones to certify zero line regressions.
explain.metamorphic.instability: Metamorphic stability violation: excessive positional jitter or verdict flip under perturbation.
explain.metamorphic.invalid_image: Metamorphic harness failed: input image buffer invalid.
autotune.hint: Environmental auto-tuning and optical health: monitors 9-zone MTF mount tilt (Scheimpflug error), ambient sunlight/lighting drift, lens dust, and closed-loop applicator eccentricity.
autotune.fail_on_critical: Fail Safe (NG) on Critical Tilt / Defect
explain.autotune.tilt: Optical mount tilt: unequal focal plane across field of view.
explain.autotune.dust: Lens optic contaminated: excessive dust spots.
measure.hint: Measures distances, widths, edges and circles using high-precision sub-pixel calipers.
blob.hint: Finds, counts and filters blobs and connected components by area.
inspect.hint: Golden template and variation model: learns process appearance across good parts and detects surface defects.
anomaly.hint: Pattern Match: learns the surface from good parts and detects scratches, voids, dents and surface defects.
code.min_length: Fewest characters (as printed, check digit included)
code.check_digit.strip: Must be correct, remove from text
code.quiet_zone: Ends of the barcode must be clear (quiet zone)
explain.blob.none: Nothing found. Check the light and the threshold.
explain.blob.too_few: Too few spots found. Missing ones are where nothing is marked.
explain.blob.too_many: Too many spots found. Extra spots are marked red.
explain.blob.present: Spots were found where none are allowed. They are marked red.
explain.blob.area: A spot is too small or too large. It is marked red.
explain.blob.total_area: The spots together cover too little or too much.
explain.blob.image_dark: The picture is almost black. Check the light and the camera.
explain.blob.image_bright: The picture is almost white. Check the exposure, the light and that nothing covers the part.
explain.blob.incomplete: Too many spots to measure in time. Check the threshold and the light.
explain.blob.setup: This count tool is not set up so that a part can pass. Open the job and fix the tool.
explain.blob.region: The area to check is partly outside the picture. Check the part's position and the area.
explain.contour.dent: The outline has a dent deeper than allowed. It is marked red.
explain.contour.deviation: The outline differs from the taught one more than allowed. The place is marked red.
explain.contour.convexity: The outline is not as full as needed: it has dents or gaps. Check the part.
explain.contour.not_closed: Outline is broken. Improve the contrast at the edge, and keep the part inside the area.
explain.code.setup: This code tool is not set up so that a part can pass. Open the job and fix the tool.
explain.code1d.quiet_zone: Something is printed too close to the barcode ends. Keep 10 bar widths clear.
explain.code1d.check_digit: Check digit is wrong. The code may be misprinted.
explain.code1d.too_short: Only part of the barcode was read. Make sure the whole barcode is in the box.
explain.code1d.addon_missing: The small add-on barcode (2 or 5 digits) next to the main barcode is missing or could not be read. Check it is printed and inside the box.
explain.code1d.addon_wrong: The add-on barcode holds the wrong number. Check the label is for this batch.
text.lines_hint: One row per printed line. Template: fixed text with fields like {BATCH}, {MRP}, {TIME:HH:mm+-3}. Full text: typed in full at batch start.
text.render_hint: The characters are drawn with an installed font instead of taught from print. Pick the font the printer uses, the height of a capital letter in this picture, and every character the print may hold; the fixed text of the lines is added by itself. Learn good parts for print quality limits.
text.font_hint: Taught font: {0} characters. Type what is printed on a line of this picture and teach it; teach every character the print uses, from two or three prints.
text.font_type_text: Type what is printed on the line first.
text.font_read: Read this line with the font
text.font_ask: Type the {0} empty characters. Check the others too.
text.font_all_sure: Every character read well. Check them, then teach.
text.font_ask_hint: One box per character. Empty boxes: the font is not sure. Change any box that is wrong.
text.font_char_hint: Characters not read well in this picture. Type what is printed and teach it.
text.font_type_char: Type the one character printed there.
explain.format.setup: This text tool is not set up so that a part can pass. Open the job and fix the tool.
explain.format.price_invalid: The price {0} is not a real price. Check the printer text.
explain.ocr.unknown_char: Character {0} is not in the taught font. Teach it.
explain.ocr.layout: The text does not fit the layout set for it: a line, a character or a word gap is missing or extra. Check the print, or learn the layout again from a good part.
explain.ocr.cut_short: The text may go on past this line: the area's edge cuts it, or more print is in line with it. Check the area and the print.
explain.caliper.no_edge: No edge found here. Check the light or move the box.
explain.caliper.weak_edge: The edge is faint. Improve the light or the contrast.
explain.caliper.out_of_tolerance: The size is outside the allowed range. Check the part.
explain.caliper.many_edges: Several edges found. Make the box smaller or clean the part.
explain.line.not_found: Edge not found along the line. Check the light or move the line.
explain.line.broken: Only part of the edge was found. The edge may be damaged or dirty.
explain.line.angle: The edge is at an angle outside the allowed range. Check that the part sits straight.
explain.line.straightness: The edge is not straight enough. The part may be bent or damaged.
explain.circle.not_found: Hole not found. Check that the hole is there and lit.
explain.circle.out_of_round: The hole is out of round. Check the part.
explain.circle.diameter: The hole's size is outside the allowed range. Check the part.
explain.geometry.out_of_tolerance: A distance or angle between features is outside the allowed range. Check the part.
explain.measure.off_image: The measuring box is off the image. Check that the part is in place.
explain.measure.no_calibration: Sizes in mm need the camera's real size. Calibrate the camera.
explain.measure.not_measured: The size could not be measured. Check the light and the part.
explain.ellipse.not_found: Oval hole not found. Check that the hole is there and lit.
explain.corner.not_found: Corner not found. Check that the corner is in the box.
explain.corner.angle: The corner's angle is outside the allowed range. Check the part.
explain.gap.narrow: The gap is too narrow or closed at the red mark. Check the part.
explain.gap.wide: The gap is too wide at the red mark. Check the part.
explain.pitch.missing: A pin is missing. Check the part.
explain.pitch.bent: A pin is out of place. It may be bent.
explain.pitch.count: The number of pins is not the number expected. Check the part and the box.
explain.edges.count: The number of edges counted is not the number expected. Check the part and the light.
explain.edges.pitch: The spacing of the edges is outside the allowed range. Check the part.
explain.geometry.parallel: The two edges are parallel, so they do not meet. Check the part and the drawn features.
text.formats_hint: One row per printed line that must fit a format. Fields: {D:5} digits, {A:1} letters, {X:6} letters or digits, {MFD:DD/MM/YY} and {EXP:MMM YY} dates, {MRP} the MRP with ₹ or Rs., {PRICE} {PER} a unit sale price, {LIFE} the months of best before. A Read text tool that decides OK/NG needs a format on every line; leave it empty only with Report only ticked.
explain.text.no_rule: Read text with no format can pass a misread line: a wrong laser line often still scores above the strictness. Add a format on each line ({D:5} digits, {A:1} letters, {X:6} letters or digits, a date), use Check text with the expected text from the job, the PLC or another tool, or tick Report only. The job cannot be saved until then.
explain.text.report_only: Report only: this tool shows what it reads but does not decide OK or NG. Another tool on the camera must check the part.
text.mfd_within_days: MFD within days of today (0 = not checked)
test.title: Image test

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.name: Job
plc.title: PLC connection
plc.simulate: Start PLC test with stored pictures
plc.test_hint: Sets Done with OK or NOT OK for 2 s so the wiring can be checked at the PLC. Only while the line is stopped; it is no part and is not counted.
plc.test_question: This will send a signal to the machine. Is the machine safe?
plc.test_sent: Test signal sent for 2 s. It is not counted as a part.
plc.test_engineer: Only an engineer or admin may send test signals.
plc.refused.stop_first: Stop the line first: test signals are sent only in Teach.
plc.refused.plc_off: The PLC is not connected: it would not see the test signal.
plc.refused.run_enable: The PLC has RunEnable on: switch the line to set-up on the PLC first.
plc.refused.busy: A part is being handled with the PLC: wait until it is done.
plc.refused.latched_ng: An NG signal is on: the OK test waits until it ends.
plc.bind_hint: IP address of this PC's PLC network card; empty listens on every card.
plc.limits_hint: Keep the PLC served on a shared network (PLC-INTERFACE.md 2.1).
plc.map: Register map for the PLC programmer
plc.map_hint: Holding registers. Each register holds two bytes of the block: the low byte is the first. Full layout: docs/vision-system/PLC-INTERFACE.md section 3.
plc.out_block: Output block, 256 bytes (read in two parts: 100–224 and 225–227)
line.title: Line, wiring and instruments
line.no_diag: No diagnostics from the PLC yet: the conditions appear when the PLC program sends them (registers 40–79).
line.counts: Parts at the camera {0} · triggers sent {1} · results {2} · rejects {3} (confirmed {4}) · {5} parts/min
ls.title: Line settings (sent to the PLC)
ls.hint: Times in milliseconds. The PLC takes new values within half a second. Distances are encoder pulses.
ls.max_ng: Stop after NOT OK in a row
ls.learn_auto: Learn on the first part of every start
ls.stop_on_fail: Stop the line when a reject is not seen
ls.relearn: Learn again on the next part
ls.saved: Saved and sent to the PLC.
ls.saved_no_plc: Saved. The PLC connection is off: it gets them when connected.
ls.relearn_sent: The PLC learns the distance on the next part.
ls.cameras_hint: Cameras at the same place (front and back of the pack) share one trigger sensor and inspect the same part at the same time. A camera at its own place has its own sensor. Parts are numbered at camera 1 and followed to the one rejector; a part is rejected when any camera says NOT OK or did not inspect it.
ls.bypass_hint: Tick what this installation does not have. The PLC then ignores it and the condition shows "bypassed".
ls.bypass_qa_only: Only a QA user can change these.
ls.bypass_rejectsensor: No reject position sensor (fixed distance or time)
ls.bypass_estop: E-stop not wired to the PLC
plc.channels_hint: One trigger and one result per camera, for cameras at different places along the line (interface section 3.5).
plc.cam_in: Camera channels: trigger bits and part numbers
plc.cam_out: Camera channels: result per camera, 4 registers each
plc.set_block: Line settings, bypass and camera count
ls.own_sensor: its own sensor (own place on the line)
ls.same_as: camera {0}'s sensor (same place, e.g. front and back)
rep.title: Reports
rep.length_line: Length {0} mm ±{1} mm (min {2}, max {3}) over {4} products.
rep.no_length: No lengths: the PLC part log or the encoder scale (Line page) is missing.
rep.gap_line: Gap {0} mm on average, smallest {1} mm.
rep.touch_line: Touching groups {0} ({1} products) · out of length tolerance {2} · small gaps {3}
rep.more_in_files: The PDF and Excel reports have the full list.
rep.saved_hint: Written at the end of every shift and of every batch (settings below).
ls.length_hint: The PLC measures every product with the encoder while it passes the camera 1 sensor. One long signal of about 2 or more product lengths means products came touching (no gap): the PLC counts them as that many products and rejects them with the reason.
ls.length_counts: Since PLC start: {0} touching groups, {1} out of length, {2} small gaps.
ls.drive_vfdrs485: Delta VFD over RS-485 (run, speed, status)
ls.drive_vfdterminal: VFD run by a PLC output (FWD terminal)
ls.fault_no: NO: 97–98 or RA–RC (closes on a fault)
ls.drive_hint: Conveyor speed is sent only to a VFD on RS-485. Start (NO) and stop (NC) push buttons start and stop the line; after a stop or an E-stop press Start again. A jam stop restarts by itself when the jam clears.
ls.bypass_startstop: No start / stop push buttons (the auto input runs the line)
ls.bypass_autoinput: No line running / auto input (start / stop buttons run the line)
lic.title: Licence
lic.not_required: This PC runs without a licence check (development setting).
lic.installation_hint: give this to your supplier when the licence is issued
lic.unlicensed_count: {0} part(s) not licensed: production stops for these parts. Use parts supplied for this installation, or contact your supplier.
lic.devices_hint: Cameras are found automatically. Every part is checked against the serial numbers registered for this licence at each licence check.
lic.manual_hint: Serial numbers the software cannot read itself, from the nameplate (line controller, printer ...).
tune.title: Auto-tune on good and bad parts
tune.hint: Runs the job on saved pictures of good parts and of bad parts, and finds the Find the part and Check text settings that pass every good part and fail every bad part with the widest margin. Nothing changes until you accept; the job is then saved as a new version.
tune.step_now: Running the job as it is
tune.not_separable: These bad pictures pass every setting:
tune.good_always_fail: These good pictures fail on another check whatever the setting; look at them in Image test:
tune.discard: Keep the job as it is
tune.stop_line: Stop the line before changing the job.
tune.job_changed: The job was changed since the tune; run the tune again.
